subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should this issue remain a combined tracker until end-to-end WebChat proof covers both assistant-before-user ordering and duplicate inbound user context, or should maintainers split it across the narrower open WebChat items now?
rationale: The remaining evidence spans UI assistant final/history reconciliation and gateway durable user-turn handling, and automation cannot safely decide whether maintainers want this broad report retained, split, or closed after only partial fixes.

options.title: Keep Combined Until Proof
options.body: Leave this issue open and require one current-main or landed-PR proof pass that covers UI order, chat.history, durable transcript, and model context before closure.

options.title: Split To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the assistant duplicate half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85771 and the user-turn durability half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86946, then close only after the split is explicit.

options.title: Close As Mitigated
options.body: Treat current UI/history mitigations as sufficient and close despite lacking direct proof for the combined live symptom.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Until Proof
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and require one current-main or landed-PR proof pass that covers UI order, chat.history, durable transcript, and model context before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable user-turn transcript boundary is the harder shared owner boundary for deciding whether this needs a gateway contract change or only UI reconciliation.
